theorems.label: dominating-set-rankwidth
theorems.statement: Assuming deterministic FPT ≠ W[1], there is no deterministic effective 2^(o(p²)) N^(O(1)) Dominating Set algorithm on monopolar graphs by rank-width, linear rank-width, or the actual width of a supplied rank decomposition or vertex order.

title: An effective quadratic lower bound for unweighted Dominating Set
